steps.title: Create or sign in to Zoho account
steps.detail: Go to accounts.zoho.com and sign in or create a new Zoho account. This account will own the OAuth client.

steps.title: Open Zoho API Console and start registration
steps.detail: Navigate to https://api-console.zoho.com/, click GET STARTED, then choose your client type (Server-based for typical AI agents) and click CREATE NOW.
steps.agentAction: Open console URL and identify client type

steps.title: Fill in client details
steps.detail: Enter Client Name, Homepage URL, and Authorized Redirect URI(s). For server-based apps, redirect URI must use https:// (or http:// for localhost). Click CREATE.
steps.agentAction: Draft redirect URI list and client metadata

steps.title: Copy Client ID and Client Secret
steps.detail: After creation, open the Client Secret tab in the console to view and copy the Client ID and Client Secret. Store them securely.
steps.agentAction: None; secrets only visible in console

steps.title: Build authorization URL and request user consent
steps.detail: Construct the authorization URL: https://accounts.zoho.com/oauth/v2/auth?scope=ZohoCRM.modules.ALL&client_id={CLIENT_ID}&response_type=code&access_type=offline&redirect_uri={REDIRECT_URI}&state={STATE}. Direct the user to this URL to grant consent.
steps.agentAction: Generate authorization URL with required scopes and PKCE if supported

steps.title: Exchange authorization code for access and refresh tokens
steps.detail: POST to https://accounts.zoho.com/oauth/v2/token with grant_type=authorization_code, code={AUTH_CODE}, client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri. Save the refresh_token for long-lived access.
steps.agentAction: Make token exchange request and store refresh token securely

steps.title: Call Zoho CRM API with access token
steps.detail: Include Authorization: Bearer {ACCESS_TOKEN} header in API requests to https://www.zohoapis.com/crm/v8/... Access tokens expire in 1 hour.
steps.agentAction: Make test API call to verify token works

steps.title: Implement token refresh logic
steps.detail: When access token expires, POST to https://accounts.zoho.com/oauth/v2/token with grant_type=refresh_token, refresh_token={REFRESH_TOKEN}, client_id, client_secret to obtain a new access token.
steps.agentAction: Implement automatic refresh before token expiry

claims.text: A Zoho account is required to access the API Console and register OAuth clients.

evidence.quote: To access the resources of Zoho using the various Zoho APIs, you will need to register your application with Zoho first.

claims.text: OAuth clients are registered at https://api-console.zoho.com/ where you get Client ID and Client Secret.

evidence.quote: Go to Zoho API console (https://api-console.zoho.com/), then click GET STARTED. ... On successful registration of your application, you will get a Client ID and Client secret.

claims.text: Five client types are supported: Server-based, Client-based, Mobile-based, Non-browser based, and Self client.

evidence.quote: You can register your application as one of the following client types: Server-based application, Client-based application, Mobile-based application, Non-browser based application, Self client

claims.text: Authorized Redirect URI must be provided for server-based, client-based, and mobile apps; must start with https:// or http://.

evidence.quote: Authorized Redirect URI ... The URI should begin with https:// or http://. You can add multiple redirect URIs by clicking [plus].

claims.text: Scopes must be specified in the authorization request; Zoho CRM uses scopes like ZohoCRM.modules.ALL.

evidence.quote: OAuth Scopes ... Scopes ... Step1: Registering a Client ... Step2: Making the Authorization Request

claims.text: Authorization code flow: redirect user to accounts.zoho.com/oauth/v2/auth with scope, client_id, response_type=code, access_type=offline, redirect_uri, state.

evidence.quote: Server-based apps can use the authorization code flow to generate an access token ... access token will be provided only after the user grants permission through consent.

claims.text: Exchange authorization code for tokens via POST to accounts.zoho.com/oauth/v2/token with grant_type=authorization_code.

evidence.quote: Get access token ... Server-based apps can use the authorization code flow to generate an access token

claims.text: Access tokens expire in 1 hour; refresh tokens can be used to obtain new access tokens via grant_type=refresh_token.

evidence.quote: Access tokens have limited validity, i.e., their lifetime is only 1 hour ... a refresh token can be retrieved and stored. This refresh token allows the app to generate a new access token whenever required.

claims.text: API calls use Bearer token in Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer {access-token-value}.

evidence.quote: Zoho's OAuth implementation uses Bearer authentication scheme ... Authorization: Bearer <space> {access-token-value}

claims.text: Apps can be published to Zoho Marketplace after review, or shared privately with invited clients via Developer Portal.

evidence.quote: The developer then has the ability to access the Zoho Developer Portal for the purpose of creating applications and for privately sharing the applications with clients, publishing them in the marketplace for free or on a paid basis

verdict.label: Instant
verdict.s2Limit: No published limit; private sharing via Zoho Developer Portal clients tab
verdict.oneLiner: Register a server-based client at api-console.zoho.com, configure redirect URIs, and use authorization code flow with refresh tokens for long-lived access.

blockers.fix: Ensure the redirect_uri parameter matches a URI listed in the Authorized Redirect URIs field in the console. Use https:// for production.
blockers.cause: Redirect URI in authorization request does not exactly match one registered in API Console (including scheme, host, path).

blockers.fix: Use exact scope names from Zoho CRM API documentation (e.g., ZohoCRM.modules.ALL). Check scope spelling and availability.
blockers.cause: Requested scope name is not recognized or not enabled for the client.

blockers.fix: Use the stored refresh token to obtain a new access token before making API calls.
blockers.cause: Access tokens are valid for 1 hour only.

blockers.fix: Re-run the authorization code flow to obtain a new refresh token.
blockers.cause: Refresh token was revoked, expired, or used after access token revocation.
